recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-37629 in the current core build.
issue_request: FHIR-37629 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the R4B core search page. It reported GET [base]/Patient?identifier:otype=... in the token search example and requested replacing :otype with the correct :of-type modifier.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-37629 was found. The same typo family was already represented by FHIR-33422, and commit 38cfead26dd23a4261c1cfabe88975e5133d6fb5 changed source/search.html from identifier:otype to identifier:of-type for both GET and POST displays after FHIR-37629 was resolved.
additional_context: source/search.html is the active core search page, and source/fhir.ini's search-rules comments point maintainers to the search.html summary table. FHIR-33422 and FHIR-37690 are same-change-family issues already represented on the combined branch. A 2020 Zulip implementers thread also confirmed identifier:otype was a typo and that the correct modifier spelling is of-type; direct FHIR-37629 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting records.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/search.html already contains the corrected identifier:of-type examples and no identifier:otype or identifier:of_type occurrence remains in that source file.
